        routes = [r for r in routes if r]
        return routes, improved_any

    # Instance-conditioned effort (deterministic)
    desc = instance.get("descriptors", {}) or {}
    corridor = desc.get("corridor", 0.0)
    trap = desc.get("trap", 0.0)
    grid_like = 1 if desc.get("structure", "") == "grid_like" else 0
    passes = 2
    if corridor < 0.05:
        passes = 3
    elif corridor < 0.1:
        passes = 2
    if trap > 0.07:
        passes = max(passes, 3)
    if grid_like:
        passes = max(passes, 3)

    # Intra-route then inter-route
    for r in routes:
        if len(r) >= 4:
            two_opt_improve(r)

    routes, _ = relocate_improve(routes, max_passes=passes)

    return routes
